commits.message: Turn the Windows operator into a real Notepad/Word desktop path.

payload_schemas.notes: path is owned-root relative. expected is document text. receipts hash values; they do not include raw document text.
sets clipboard then pastes only into the bound control. same OperatorAction contract as replace_text.

real_substrate_proofs: Notepad open_artifact_and_assert hash match on WindowsApps Notepad.exe window-owning PID
replace_text COMPLETED on DocumentControl Text editor
Word desktop.open rebound to window-owning PID distinct from Notepad
ProcessIdentityMismatch after killing demo Notepad PID
Explorer /separate launch+close without killing owner shell explorer 13212
cross_lane_assumptions: Lane 4 composes desktop.open_artifact_and_assert with owned-root relative path, allowlisted absolute executable, and expected document text.
ProcessIdentity is pid+create_time+live image path. Win11 Notepad live image is WindowsApps Notepad.exe, not System32 notepad.exe.
WindowIdentity.to_selector omits title because Notepad prefixes * when dirty.
desktop.open with show_window=true waits for a new window; show_window=false does not.
Control string values are redacted to sha256/length in receipts.
Single-instance reuse of a pre-existing app is FAILED existing_instance_reused, not adopted.
likely_conflicts: personal_operator._launch_process no longer requires live exe path == allowlisted path (App Execution Alias).
desktop.open now post-binds GUI file opens when show_window is true.
New fabric action kinds desktop.open_artifact_and_assert and desktop.control.paste.
integration_order_notes: Land Lane 2 before Lane 4 cross-app compose that calls open_artifact_and_assert.
Lane 1 browser and Lane 3 GitHub are independent.
Do not merge this branch to main from this lane.
known_semantic_conflicts: Win11 Notepad File flyout did not expose an exact Open MenuItem/Button on this PC, so File Open is implemented but not live-proven.
type/paste dispatch on Win11 Notepad DocumentControl timed out on value readback (UNKNOWN timeout_after_possible_effect). replace_text Value pattern is the proven edit path.
next_highest_value_work: Prove File Open/Save As against Win11 Notepad or Word IFileDialog, including picker-host process if the dialog is not in the app PID.
Make type/paste readback succeed on RichEditD2DPT (TextPattern vs ValuePattern after SendKeys).
Unique Word document window selection when Word has multiple HWNDs.
Focus return to a Notepad window after another app is foregrounded.
Excel open+readback if a stable cell UIA value is available.
